questions.question: Distinguish between normative ethics and applied ethics. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:

  • Applied ethics deals with specific issues. It is practical

questions.question: Analyse the relationship between corporate governance and business ethics. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:

  • governance is necessary to build trust among its stakeholders. Together they
  • promote the goodwill of the company
